Input: `OUTPUT/rds/spe_ruv.rds` (03)
Output: Figure3ab, 3cd, 3ef, 3gh (3cd and 3gh also .pdf) in `OUTPUT/FIGURES/Main/Figure3`, source data 3a-3h in `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Main/Figure3`; `OUTPUT/TABLES/Figure3ad.xlsx`, `Figure3eh.xlsx`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))

keep <- spe_ruv$Segment == "PanCK" & spe_ruv$Group %in% c("Epithelial", "Atypical Epithelial", "Cancer")
spe_sub <- spe_ruv[, keep]
dge <- spe_to_dge(spe_ruv)[, keep]

# One group per category and compartment; endometriosis epithelium (including the
# atypical epithelium of AE) is labelled by its category only
category_group <- paste0(spe_sub$Category, "_", gsub("Atypical Epithelial", "Epithelial", spe_sub$Group))
colData(spe_sub)$Category_Group <- gsub("^(Atypical endometriosis|Endometriosis CLE|Simple endometriosis)_Epithelial$",
                                        "\\1", category_group)
table(colData(spe_sub)$Category_Group)
```

##### Differential expression
```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~0 + Category_Group + ruv_W1 + ruv_W2 + ruv_W3, data = colData(spe_sub)) %>%
  tidy_design("Category_Group")
contr.matrix <- makeContrasts(CCCe_SE = Clear_cell_carcinoma_Epithelial - Simple_endometriosis,
                              CCCc_SE = Clear_cell_carcinoma_Cancer - Simple_endometriosis,
                              ECe_SE = Endometrioid_carcinoma_Epithelial - Simple_endometriosis,
                              ECc_SE = Endometrioid_carcinoma_Cancer - Simple_endometriosis,
                              CCCe_ECLE = Clear_cell_carcinoma_Epithelial - Endometriosis_CLE,
                              CCCc_ECLE = Clear_cell_carcinoma_Cancer - Endometriosis_CLE,
                              ECe_ECLE = Endometrioid_carcinoma_Epithelial - Endometriosis_CLE,
                              ECc_ECLE = Endometrioid_carcinoma_Cancer - Endometriosis_CLE,
                              levels = colnames(design))

efit <- fit_dge(dge, design, contr.matrix, block = factor(colData(spe_sub)$Patient))$efit

tables <- lapply(setNames(colnames(contr.matrix), colnames(contr.matrix)), function(coef) top_table(efit, coef))
vs_SE  <- c("CCCe_SE", "CCCc_SE", "ECe_SE", "ECc_SE")
vs_ECLE <- c("CCCe_ECLE", "CCCc_ECLE", "ECe_ECLE", "ECc_ECLE")

save_tables(setNames(tables[vs_SE], paste0("PanCK_", vs_SE)), "Figure3ad.xlsx")
save_tables(setNames(tables[vs_ECLE], paste0("PanCK_", vs_ECLE)), "Figure3eh.xlsx")
```

##### Volcano plots (Figure 3a-b vs SE, 3e-f vs ECLE)
```{r, fig.width = 24, fig.height = 6}
cancer_colours <- c(CCCe = Category_Group[["Clear cell carcinoma - Epithelial"]], CCCc = Category_Group[["Clear cell carcinoma - Cancer"]],
                    ECe = Category_Group[["Endometrioid carcinoma - Epithelial"]], ECc = Category_Group[["Endometrioid carcinoma - Cancer"]])

volcanos <- function(contrasts, reference, col_reference, xlim, ylim, caption_x, caption_y) {
  plots <- lapply(contrasts, function(coef) {
    group <- sub("_.*", "", coef)
    plot_volcano(tables[[coef]], sig_genes_in(tables[[coef]], volcano_genes_cancer),
                 col_low = col_reference, col_high = cancer_colours[[group]], xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
                 left = reference, right = group, caption_x = caption_x, caption_y = caption_y,
                 print_scale = 539 / 1728, label_pt = 4.2, caption_pt = 5)   # 24 in printed 539 pt wide; narrow panels
  })
  wrap_plots(plots) + plot_layout(ncol = 4)
}

Figure3ab <- volcanos(vs_SE, "SE", Category[["Simple endometriosis"]], xlim = c(-6, 6), ylim = c(0, 8), caption_x = 4, caption_y = 7)
Figure3ef <- volcanos(vs_ECLE, "ECLE", Category[["Endometriosis CLE"]], xlim = c(-7, 7), ylim = c(0, 11.5), caption_x = 4.6, caption_y = 9.9)
Figure3ab
Figure3ef

save_plot(Figure3ab, "Figure3ab.svg", width = 24, height = 6)
save_plot(Figure3ef, "Figure3ef.svg", width = 24, height = 6)

# Source data: one workbook per panel, epithelium (left) and cancer (right) sheets;
# the four volcano plots of each row are, in order, CCCe, CCCc, ECe, ECc
volcano_panels <- function(row, contrasts, i) setNames(lapply(i, function(k) volcano_source(row[[k]])), contrasts[i])
save_source_data(volcano_panels(Figure3ab, vs_SE, 1:2), "Figure3a")
save_source_data(volcano_panels(Figure3ab, vs_SE, 3:4), "Figure3b")
save_source_data(volcano_panels(Figure3ef, vs_ECLE, 1:2), "Figure3e")
save_source_data(volcano_panels(Figure3ef, vs_ECLE, 3:4), "Figure3f")
```

##### GSEA, MSigDB Hallmarks (Figure 3c-d vs SE, 3g-h vs ECLE)
```{r}
hallmarks <- msigdb_sets()
gseaMsigdbr_list <- lapply(setNames(names(tables), names(tables)),
                           function(coef) gsea_hallmark(ranked_logfc(efit, coef), hallmarks))

# Narrow, tall panels so the text stays readable on the page: names on one line,
# captions starting at NES = 0, the two legends side by side
gsea_panels <- function(contrasts, reference) {
  plots <- lapply(contrasts, function(coef)
    plot_gsea(gseaMsigdbr_list[[coef]], label_format = 34, right = sub("_.*", "", coef), left = reference,
              caption_size = 2.2, captions_at_zero = TRUE) +
      gsea_theme(0.5, 30, nes_breaks = c(-3, 0, 3), nes_limits = c(-4, 4)) +
      scale_size(range = c(1.5, 5), breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(3)) +
      theme(legend.box = "horizontal", legend.key.width = unit(0.6, "cm"), legend.title.position = "top",
            legend.text = element_text(size = 6), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5, lineheight = 0.8)))
  wrap_plots(plots) + plot_layout(ncol = 4)
}

gsea_panel <- function(contrasts) lapply(gseaMsigdbr_list[contrasts], gsea_source)
```

```{r, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 4.5}
Figure3cd <- gsea_panels(vs_SE, "SE")
Figure3cd

save_plot(Figure3cd, "Figure3cd.pdf", width = 13, height = 4.5)
save_plot(Figure3cd, "Figure3cd.svg", width = 13, height = 4.5)
save_source_data(gsea_panel(c("CCCe_SE", "CCCc_SE")), "Figure3c")
save_source_data(gsea_panel(c("ECe_SE", "ECc_SE")), "Figure3d")
```

```{r, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 5.5}
Figure3gh <- gsea_panels(vs_ECLE, "ECLE")
Figure3gh

save_plot(Figure3gh, "Figure3gh.pdf", width = 13, height = 5.5)
save_plot(Figure3gh, "Figure3gh.svg", width = 13, height = 5.5)
save_source_data(gsea_panel(c("CCCe_ECLE", "CCCc_ECLE")), "Figure3g")
save_source_data(gsea_panel(c("ECe_ECLE", "ECc_ECLE")), "Figure3h")
```
